description: Implementation class of PaymentService handling premium payments and claim payouts in an insurance management system. Provides methods for recording payments, both premiums and claim payouts, and listing payments for a specific customer.

classes.name: PaymentServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing PaymentService to handle payment operations such as recording premium payments, claim payouts, and listing payments for customers.

methods.name: recordPremiumPayment
methods.description: Records a premium payment for a customer policy, generating a unique reference, and saving the payment record.

methods.name: recordClaimPayout
methods.description: Records a claim payout payment linked to a claim, customer policy, and customer.

methods.name: listForCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of payments associated with a specific customer.
